primary-container.note: Matches, but no longer used for selected rows (owner, D30): small marks only.

secondary.note: Not shown in the composition: required by color.roles.required; neutral, because Relay has no second hue.

on-secondary.note: Not shown in the composition: required by color.roles.required; neutral, because Relay has no second hue.

surface-hover.note: The composition had two hovers: rows at neutral 50 (nearly invisible on white) and nav/menu items at 150. Relay uses one hover role at 100, one stop darker than the page, so row hover is visible without looking selected.

surface-overlay-hover.note: Light: same as surface-hover. Dark: 750, one stop lighter than the menu it sits on (color.dark.surface-steps); 850 would be darker than the menu.

border-strong.note: Light moved from 450 to 500 at the foundations review so an unchecked checkbox edge still meets 3:1 on surface-selected (3.61); both themes now use 500.

error.note: 550 matches the composition's dot; the same role is also used for error text on surfaces (passes).

on-error.note: Not shown in the composition: text on a solid feedback fill, required by color.roles.required.

error-container.note: Matches. Used for chips and other small marks only; inline messages sit on surface-subtle with the status color in the icon and title (owner, D30).

warning.note: The composition's amber 450 dot was below 3:1 on its chip and fails as text. 550 passes both.

on-warning.note: Not shown in the composition: text on a solid feedback fill, required by color.roles.required.

warning-container.note: Matches. Used for chips and other small marks only; inline messages sit on surface-subtle with the status color in the icon and title (owner, D30).

on-success.note: Not shown in the composition: text on a solid feedback fill, required by color.roles.required.

success-container.note: Matches. Used for chips and other small marks only; inline messages sit on surface-subtle with the status color in the icon and title (owner, D30).

on-info.note: Not shown in the composition: text on a solid feedback fill, required by color.roles.required.

info-container.note: Matches. Used for chips and other small marks only; inline messages sit on surface-subtle with the status color in the icon and title (owner, D30).

scrim.note: Not shown in the composition: the dimming layer behind dialogs (shape.tokens).

surface-selected.note: Changed at the foundations review (owner, D30): selection is a neutral step stronger than hover (light 150 over hover 100; dark 800 over hover 850 on 900 panels), with the accent only on the checked box and the left edge. The preview's accent tint was invisible in light and a deep violet band in dark.
